Market today: The chip sector is facing a deep sell-off, with SK Hynix plunging and US/Korean tech stocks now tightly linked. This negative sentiment is the primary driver for your tech-heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-49.65%) and SPAL (-56.9%) are leveraged ETFs with massive losses and decay; their default stops are far off. QQQ (-4.55%) and SMH (-13.8%) are also under pressure with SELL/TRIM statuses. Margin amplifies these drawdowns significantly.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the broader chip sector for any signs of stabilization or further weakness. Also, monitor your leveraged positions for potential stop adjustments.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management and stop discipline, especially on leveraged and underperforming tech/chip positions.
plays: Re-evaluate stops on SOXL and SPAL. Their leveraged nature and deep losses mean default stops may not be adequate; consider adjusting to protect capital.
Monitor QQQ and SMH closely. The deepening chip sell-off puts these core tech/chip holdings at risk of further downside.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market sentiment for tech/chips is too uncertain for new long positions.
